title: A Q-learning-based QoS-aware multipath routing protocol in IoMT-based wireless body area network
abstract: arXiv:2604.15489v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) enables intelligent healthcare services but faces challenges such as dynamic topology, energy constraints, and diverse QoS requirements. This paper proposes QQMR, a Q-learning-based QoS-aware multipath routing method for WBANs. QQMR classifies data into three priority levels and employs adaptive multi-level queuing and fuzzy C-means clustering to optimize routing decisions. It maintains separate learning policies for each data type and selects primary and backup paths accordingly. Experimental results demonstrate improved packet delivery ratio and significant reductions in delay, routing overhead, and energy consumption compared to existing methods.

translated_title: 基于Q学习的医疗物联网无线体域网QoS感知多路径路由协议
translated_abstract: 摘要：医疗物联网（IoMT）支持智能医疗服务，但面临动态拓扑、能源限制和多样化服务质量（QoS）需求等挑战。本文提出QQMR，一种基于Q学习的QoS感知多路径路由方法，用于无线体域网（WBANs）。QQMR将数据分为三个优先级级别，并采用自适应多级队列和模糊C均值聚类来优化路由决策。它为每种数据类型维护独立的学习策略，并据此选择主路径和备用路径。实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，QQMR在数据包投递率方面有所提高，并在延迟、路由开销和能源消耗方面显著减少。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Q学习的QoS感知多路径路由协议（QQMR），通过优先级分类和自适应学习策略，在医疗物联网WBAN中实现了更高的数据包投递率并显著降低了延迟、开销和能耗。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Q-learning-based QoS-aware multipath routing protocol (QQMR) that uses priority classification and adaptive learning strategies to achieve higher packet delivery ratio and significantly lower delay, overhead, and energy consumption in IoMT-based WBANs.
